_comment: The expected suite spine AND the runner-owned bars for the FridgeLuck overhaul scorecard. Suites A-G and their owners come from PLAN.md 'The scorecard (evals first)' on docs/spec-overhaul-20261011 (revision 2, 2026-10-11). The bars are the lead's choice, not measured optima: a suite can only move a bar with a recorded reason (a change to this registry citing PLAN.md or an operator decision). Suites must emit metric ids and labels that match this registry exactly; they may omit bars (the runner injects the registered bar) and their own bars are never trusted: a missing metric, an extra metric, or a different label/op/value FAILS with a reason naming the exact mismatch. interval_required: true marks a bar that applies to the metric's 95% interval low end; a point estimate without an interval cannot pass. platform: 'any' runs on any host; 'macos' suites run only on macOS and are imported from committed out/<id>/results.json elsewhere (matching head + CI-run provenance required - see SCORECARD.md).

stock_counted_twice.source: PLAN.md row A: 0 stock counted twice

plan_battery_rows_present.reason: completeness row delivered by suite A (eval/suite-pantry-truth 564482c): the plan-probe battery must fail closed when required PLAN.md battery rows are missing, so presence of all 3 rows is itself a bar (== 3), not silent decoration

ndcg10_vs_rule_ranker_pct.label: NDCG@10 vs the rule ranker: relative gain among feasible picks (95% interval low, %)
ndcg10_vs_rule_ranker_pct.source: PLAN.md row B: engine beats the current rule ranker on NDCG@10 with the 95% interval above 0 and at least +10% relative
ndcg10_vs_rule_ranker_pct.note: The contract applies >= bars to the interval's low end, so a low end >= +10 also keeps the 95% interval above 0.
